acuteOverview.title: Invoice generation entry point
acuteOverview.takeaway: Invoice generation follows a fixed sequence: collect, price, tax, then persist and publish.

acuteOverview.title: Modules on the invoice path
acuteOverview.takeaway: Five billing modules process invoices, interacting only via `index.ts` files.

acuteOverview.title: Usage and pricing
acuteOverview.takeaway: Usage collection and pricing are handled by two functions, with one unconfirmed dependency.

acuteOverview.title: Tax
acuteOverview.takeaway: Taxwell integration lacks defined retry and timeout handling, risking invoice generation.

acuteOverview.title: Persistence and events
acuteOverview.takeaway: Invoice persistence is transactional, but event publishing has no retry mechanism.

acuteOverview.title: Data contract
acuteOverview.takeaway: The `InvoiceDraft` interface defines the data structure, with `taxCents` conditionally populated.

acuteOverview.title: Interpretation
acuteOverview.takeaway: `billing/pricing` is the pricing boundary, and `generateInvoice` orchestrates calls without its own logic.

acuteOverview.title: Open questions
acuteOverview.takeaway: Four open questions on billing process and data model.

acuteOverview.title: Summary
acuteOverview.takeaway: The invoice path is verified, but discount probability and tax retry behavior are not.

acuteOverview.title: About this map
acuteOverview.takeaway: This map details the invoice path of Ledgerline billing service based on manual code review at commit `a41c9e2`.
